# Support

- **Fuse is silent, slow or failing:** read [Troubleshooting](https://fuse.codes/troubleshooting) first. It explains each message and where the logs are.
- **A question about using Fuse:** ask in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/discussions).
- **A bug or a feature request:** open an [issue](https://github.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/issues/new/choose) with the output of `fuse --version`.
- **A vulnerability:** do not open an issue. Report it privately as [Security](https://github.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse/blob/main/SECURITY.md) describes.

The [documentation](https://fuse.codes/docs) lists every page by what you want to do.
